tools.name: start_daily_puzzle
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to play today's Words With Attitude puzzle: guess a hidden cheeky word (a mild British insult or a grim weather word) in six tries. Returns the puzzle number, the word length and an empty board, never the answer. Pass the player's time zone when it is known so the puzzle

tools.name: submit_guess
tools.description: Use this for each word the player guesses in a Words With Attitude puzzle started with start_daily_puzzle. tools.name: give_up
tools.description: Use this only when the player asks to give up on a Words With Attitude puzzle. Ends the game as a loss and returns the answer, the board and a spoiler-free share grid. Send the puzzle number and every guess made so far.

tools.name: record_card_event
tools.description: Used only by the Words card, never by the model, to record that a result was shared or a link was opened. Anonymous: no guesses, answer, location or account identifier.
